prompts:
Use case: identity-preserve / character design revision.
Edit the reference character into a youthful TEENAGE fox-eared fantasy adventurer girl. The user clarified: 是一个少女. Keep the character recognizable through her honey-golden hair, chestnut lowlights, short side ponytail, large chocolate-tipped fox ears, amber eyes, one fluffy golden-brown fox tail with a cream tip, yellow-brown ranger palette and compact wooden shortbow. Preserve the coarse low-resolution pixel-art style and real transparent background.
Make her age read as a cheerful teenage girl: a softer rounder face, round cheeks, lively clear eyes, small nose, a bright friendly smile, a slightly larger head, a short and light natural build, about 5.5–6 heads tall, youthful proportions without a mature hourglass shape. Keep the portrait full body. Friendly neutral idle stance, feet naturally placed, one hand loosely holding the shortbow downward and the other resting naturally near the utility pouch; no arched pose.
Redesign the outfit as modest, practical youthful ranger clothing: a mustard-yellow short capelet with a plain brass clasp, a loose ivory high-neck long-sleeved tunic fully covering chest, waist and abdomen, a simple ochre vest with a straight silhouette, chestnut mid-thigh adventure shorts with a normal utility belt and small pouch, fully opaque dark-brown tights, sturdy brown mid-calf lace-up boots with ochre cuffs and small fingerless gloves. Plain cloth and leather, uncomplicated cut and trims, a small quiver at the hip. Keep the clothes opaque and comfortably loose, no corset or exposed midriff, no thigh straps. Hair, tail and cape use large simple readable color clusters.
Color: honey yellow, ochre, caramel, chestnut brown and cream dominate, deep plum-indigo outline, tiny brass accents. Keep the palette soft and limited, approximately 16–22 colors, flat 2–3 shade ramps per material.
CRITICAL: visibly COARSE pixel art with LARGE square pixels, consistent low-resolution logical grid, approximately 96 x 144 logical pixels for the entire figure, nearest-neighbor enlarged presentation. Face about 14 logical pixels across. One logical-pixel stepped dark outline. Eliminate tiny details, fine strands, smooth lines, dithering noise and ornate accessories. No anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no painterly shading, no 3D. This must look like a low-resolution hand-pixeled game character, not a high-resolution illustration with a pixel filter.
ONE character only, all ears, bow, feet and complete tail inside the frame with transparent margins. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No scenery, no shadow, no labels, no text, no panels, no watermark.

Use case: background-extraction.
Edit ONLY the background and cutout edges of this image. Keep the EXACT SAME cheerful youthful fox-eared adventurer girl: same teenage face, friendly smile, honey-golden hair, fox ears, golden-brown tail, fully covering ivory long-sleeved tunic, mustard cape, brown vest, shorts over opaque tights, brown boots, bow, pose, proportions, composition and coarse pixel art. Do not redesign or mature the character.
REMOVE ALL of the purple/brown/black background haze, all aura/glow, all shadows and ALL soft partially transparent pixels outside the character and equipment. The background, gaps around the bow and bowstring, gaps between limbs, and spaces around the ears and tail must be genuinely fully transparent alpha=0. No colored background, no gradient, no glow, no cast shadow, no checkerboard image.
Preserve crisp square pixel boundaries and the dark plum pixel outline. Every edge of the character and bow must have a hard pixel-art silhouette; no antialiasing, feathering, blur or halo. Preserve the original colors and all actual character pixels, including the thin bowstring. Keep the full figure inside the frame, with comfortable transparent margin. One character only, no text or watermark. Output a truly transparent-background PNG.
